events.description: A multi-player on-ice fight erupts near the net, involving at least five players (including #3, #62, #21, #91, #86) from two teams, with punches thrown, grappling, and players being pulled apart by referees throughout the sequence.

Multiple players from opposing teams are engaged in a sustained physical altercation near the net, involving grappling, pushing, and shoving; referees actively intervene to separate them throughout the sequence.

Two ice hockey players engage in a mutual physical fight: the player in the white jersey (No. 3) and the player in the black jersey (No. 81) exchange punches and grapple, culminating in both falling to the ice.

After the opponent is down on the ice, the player in the white jersey (No. 3) continues to strike the fallen player (No. 81), who is unable to defend himself — constituting abuse of a helpless victim.
Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained physical altercation near the goal crease, involving grappling, pushing, and shoving; referees intervene to separate them.
A player in black (Cernak, #81) appears to strike or push a downed opponent (Capitals goalie #70) who is on the ice and unable to defend himself, while others are engaged in the fight nearby.

Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a multi-person scrum near the net, with punching, grappling, and shoving observed across frames. Players in white (Capitals) and dark (Lightning) jerseys are actively exchanging blows and entangled.

A player in a dark jersey (No. 21) appears to deliver repeated punches to a downed or heavily restrained opponent near the goal crease while the goalie is on the ice; the victim is unable to effectively defend himself during this interval.

After the main scrum disperses, a separate one-on-one confrontation occurs between two players (one in dark jersey No. 86, one in white jersey No. 43), involving grabbing and pushing, as seen just before the final frame.
